plugin.shortDescription: Design Thinking and Scrum Sprint guidance
plugin.longDescription: Four kernels (ideo-kernel, scrum-kernel, sprint-kernel, design-kernel) and four roles (Scrum Master, Designer, Developer, Stakeholder). Every role loads the IDEO and Scrum kernels; the sprint and design kernels load when a Sprint or a design sprint opens. IDEO methods form a shared toolbox; designs yield prototypes and findings, while Sprints deliver Increments. Conventions and templates ship with the plugin.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan the next Sprint, including its Sprint Goal and scope.
Research whether this idea is worth pursuing and test a prototype.
Help me inspect this Increment and prepare the Sprint Review and Retrospective.

scrum-master.short_description: Guide Scrum, refinement, delegation, tracking, and review
scrum-master.default_prompt: $scrum-master Review the project and help me prepare its next Scrum event.

designer.short_description: Research problems, explore options, and test prototypes
designer.default_prompt: $designer Help me research this problem and test a prototype.

developer.short_description: Plan How; build with PO go-ahead; keep Sprint logs and DoD proof
developer.default_prompt: $developer Read the project and Sprint log, then propose a plan.

stakeholder.short_description: Assess Increments or prototypes as a named stakeholder
stakeholder.default_prompt: $stakeholder Assess this Increment as the specified stakeholder from the product log.
